quotes.author: Theresa M
quotes.text: We choose Elmer's Boat Rental every year for our annual boating/tubing trip for my son's birthday. They are so efficient and helpful. They are always cheerful and really assist with creating a seamless experience of renting the boat and getting the sporting package. You can bring your own life jackets or use theirs. We prefer ours. You can bring snacks and drinks on the boat. Do remember that you have limited space, but you can store items under the seats as well. This most recent trip we had my husband, me, an 8 year old, two 14 year olds, and three 12 year olds.

quotes.author: Ines S
quotes.text: I booked online boat for my husband’s birthday . Everything went smoothly as well as we were there. The stuff was great. We had a really great time on the lake with our friends. The boat was clean and easy to drive. Only what we missed was a more time then 4 hours that I booked but since I booked this boat last minute and was it holiday weekend July, 4th, I was happy to have it at all. Looking forward to make again this trip. Thank you .

quotes.author: amyp
quotes.text: This was a great rental. We hired a captain. His name was Tristan and grew up in Lake Geneva so he had a wealth of knowledge about the homes along the lake. He stopped at any bar/restaurant on the lake we wanted and dropped anchor for us to swim. I am glad we hired a captain because the lake was very busy on July 3. I would hire this company and Tristan again!

quotes.author: Navigator827697
quotes.text: We had a great day in the lake in a pontoon boat from Elmer’s. It was comfortable, clean and tan like a charm. Staff friendly and attentive as well as informative and helpful. We also rented the tube package and have our grandkids (13 and 8) a fun ride. Had lunch that we had packed. Great day!

quotes.author: Jose M
quotes.text: Great service. Easy to book, gracious with use time. We were 30mins early they sent us out and back 15 mins late no issues or surprise charges. Boat was clean and performed great . Would recommend and we will definitely be back.
